image_description: A grey whale surfacing in calm, grey ocean waters. The whale's head and upper back are visible above the waterline, showing a spout of mist from its blowholes. The skin appears dark grey with lighter mottling. The background is a hazy horizon line separating the sea and sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is consistent with a grey whale, and a distinct spout (indicating blowholes) is visible erupting from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin shows characteristic mottling and lighter speckles consistent with barnacle/cyamid coverage found on grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only captures the head and immediate shoulder region. The posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located is submerged or out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior portion of the whale is visible; the full body shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; visible skin texture matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and underwater; baleen plates are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located further back on the body and are submerged/not visible in this framing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution allows for seeing the rough, uneven texture of the skin on the head, consistent with callosities.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The water ripples immediately surrounding the whale lack some high-frequency detail and appear slightly 'smudged' or painterly compared to the foreground waves, suggesting minor generation artifacts in fluid dynamics simulation.
The horizon is extremely soft and blends into the sky. While this could be atmospheric fog, it also resembles common AI blurring of distant backgrounds.
